english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving something gently or forcefully back and forth, with the intensity supplied by context.
Use this for something moving loosely back and forth, such as a flag moving in the breeze.

examples.english: Rock the chair gently so I can wipe it clean.
examples.traditional: 你輕輕搖吓張櫈，等我抹乾淨。
